title: Mod demography model sections
description: Content/demography/model.json: sections of the shipped demography_model.json to replace wholesale (for example a pre-modern life table). A listed section must be complete and has the shape of the shipped one (101 ages; grids as [rows][ages] arrays, distributions summing to 1 over both sexes); the game validates it with the same rules as the shipped file and keeps the shipped tables if it is rejected. Sections not listed stay as shipped.

sex_gap_male_weight.description: Weight of the male side when a mean life expectancy and sex gap are split into male and female values.

mortality.description: le_min, le_max, le_step and the monthly_q_male / monthly_q_female grids ([life-expectancy rows][101 ages]).

fertility.description: tfr_min, tfr_max, tfr_step, first_cell, cells and the shape_per_month grid.

migration.description: Immigrant / refugee arrival profiles (each pair sums to 1) and emigration / refugee propensities, 101 values per sex.

preston.description: gdppc (strictly ascending) and le arrays of equal length: the life-expectancy-by-income curve.

region_templates.description: WorldRegion name (and World) -> { male[101], female[101], le_sex_gap, sex_ratio_at_birth }; male + female must sum to 1.
